registry.description: Keeps tracks of all meters for this server

title:
Creates and manages app's set of meters.
Exporters use the meter registry to iterate over the set of meters instrumenting this server,
and then further iterate over each meter's metrics, generally resulting in a time series in the
metrics backend for each combination of metrics and dimensions.
name: App.MeterRegistry
